title: Ratio tiles with no hours show a grey dash, never 0.00%
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in a fresh test location made for this run, with no clocked time and no invoices this week (you check this in step 1).
  3. You run the whole case on one day, and not on the last evening of the week, so every record you create stays inside This Week.
  4. Technician 1: a test technician in this run's location, with Time Clock on and a department whose time clock is on (for internal, non work order time), whose sign-in you have.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu.
  2. Set the range pill to This Week on Revenue, Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization.
  3. Write down each tile's headline, its colour and the line under it.
  4. Click the arrow icon beside "Technician Efficiency", set the report's Date control to This week, and write down how the report shows an empty value.
  5. In the private window, signed in as Technician 1, click Clock In in the top bar, choose the department (not a work order), and clock out.
  6. In Reports > Timesheet Activities edit that record so it runs exactly 1.00 hour earlier today (e.g. 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM). If it cannot be edited, use the hours shown there.
  7. Click Dashboard, set Technician Utilization to This Week and write down the headline and the line under it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization each read a single hyphen "-" in grey. None reads "0.00%", none is blank and none shows an error.
  • Revenue reads $0.00 with "0 Invoices" under it, because there is no parts-and-labor split to show.
  • The report may show its own empty value differently (for example an empty number with the % sign). That difference is expected and is not a failure.
  • After 1.00 hour of internal time only, Technician Utilization reads "0.00%" with "0.00 WO Hrs / 1.00 Clocked" under it (0.00 / (0.00 + 1.00) x 100 = 0.00): a real zero, shown differently from the "-" of no hours.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9575 (S3), story SV-9576 (S4); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, S3 (S3-E3 and its context note), S4 (S4-N2, S4-R9). Design canvas row 15 (15_Empty_Design, approved 2026-10-07, to build): ratio tiles read a grey "-"; 15_Empty_Now shows today's build reading "n/a". Boards used for labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-E3: “Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization are each a ratio. When the denominator for the selected range is zero, worked hours, clocked hours, or the sum of work-order and internal hours, the measure has no value for that range. It is not zero, and the tile must not show "0.00%", because no hours recorded and a genuine zero percent are different facts. The same applies to the Revenue tile's parts-versus-labor split when revenue for the range is zero (S4-N2 already gives that tile its fallback supporting line). Inside the Technician Efficiency calculation, a work order line with invoiced technician time but no clocked time contributes no split share rather than an infinite one. The tile headline reads exactly "-", a single hyphen, in grey.”
  • S3-E3 context note: “the matching report renders its own empty cell differently, as an empty number with the percent sign still shown. Bringing the report's empty state into line is deliberately outside this spec, so a difference between the tile and the report in this one case, where neither is showing a figure, is not a failure of the parity rule in S3-R1.”
  • S4-N2: “If the Revenue tile has no parts-versus-labor split to show, its supporting line reads "{count} Invoices" instead.”
  • S4-R9: “The Technician Utilization tile shows a supporting line reading "{work-order hours} WO Hrs / {clocked hours} Clocked".”
